data.text: “Thanks, Luke. I’ll commit to 15 tons this month if everyone agrees to the full plan, but Emma should have a say before we settle on her smaller share. My family has fished this lake for years, and I want it to keep supporting all of us. Let’s keep the total at or below 50 tons and agree on a fair rotation before next month. Emma, are you comfortable with 5 tons for this opening month, or would you prefer we each take 10?”
